project_type: FastAPI Python backend + React/TypeScript Vite frontend, SQLite storage, monorepo
build_system: Backend: pip + uvicorn. Frontend: Vite (npm run build = tsc -b && vite build). No workspace-level build script; run frontend and backend separately.
test_framework: pytest (backend) in tests/; no frontend test framework configured
verification_instructions: 1. Activate venv or install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt. 2. Run backend tests: python -m pytest tests/ -x -q from project root. 3. Run frontend type check: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit. 4. Optional full build: cd frontend && npm run build.
environment_constraints: Do NOT start/restart the uvicorn dev server. Do NOT push to git. Tests use TestClient (no running server needed). Frontend type check requires Node.js and the node_modules installed (cd frontend && npm install first if missing).
contribution_requirements: Keep dark-navy/neon-green theme and existing visual identity intact. Do not redesign the UI. Preserve existing API contracts. No new external dependencies unless essential.
key_patterns: API constant pattern: const API = `${(import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '') || ''}/api` (being centralized into api.ts). Backend routes in backend/main.py. Storage via backend/storage.py save_analysis/get_analysis/update_analysis. AI workflow in backend/services/nebius_ai.py run_full_ai_workflow. Analyzer in analyzer/repository.py analyze_change + to_dict.
directory_structure: Project root: backend/ (main.py, storage.py, findings.py, verification.py, services/), analyzer/ (repository.py), frontend/ (src/App.tsx, src/types.ts, src/api.ts[new], src/views/, src/components/), tests/ (conftest.py, test_api.py, test_analyzer.py, test_security.py), sample-project/ (used by tests), .agents/tasks/ (plan + FEAT artifacts), requirements.txt, .env.example
